demos.name: Poppy demo
demos.description: Play the personal agent from the Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy, spec 1.0): read a Company's poppy.json, sign in to PingFederate with a URL as the client id, then call its API with a signed Poppy-Session. Step through it or ask the Agent chat (scripted or live Claude). Every request is shown raw.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 5450). Live local run needs a PingFederate with a CIMD policy for the agent URL (see docs/setup.md) and a Company that serves poppy.json. Docker: HOST_PORT=5450 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). With PAT_TLS_CERT and PAT_TLS_KEY set the app serves https only, so open https://localhost:5450 (a shelf on that machine needs a local url override). The hosted Mock card is the SE build (MODE=mock): it explains and shows an example run with invented values, and reaches nothing. The real mockUrl is set only in the shelf's local file, never in this repo (placeholder host here).
